 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform separator rows/columns partition the picture into panels.
    sep = next(v for v, n in Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).items()
               if sum(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) >= 1)
    # The separator color is the one appearing as an entire row (and column).
    sep = next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row)
               if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))
    row_bands, col_bands = [], []
    start = 0
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x == sep for x in grid[r]):
            if start < r: row_bands.append((start, r))
            start = r + 1
    if start < h: row_bands.append((start, h))
    start = 0
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h)):
            if start < c: col_bands.append((start, c))
            start = c + 1
    if start < w: col_bands.append((start, w))
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj = min((x for x in counts if x != bg), key=lambda x: counts[x])
    out = [[bg for _ in col_bands] for _ in row_bands]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_bands):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_bands):
            pts = {(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] == obj}
            if any((r + dr, c + dc) in pts for r, c in pts for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (0, 1))):
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
